title: clips/pattern
summary: A comprehensive Python web mining library that combines tools for web scraping, natural language processing, machine learning, network analysis, and data visualization into a single, easy-to-use package.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need to combine multiple libraries by providing an all-in-one solution for web data extraction, text analysis, and network visualization in Python.
why_valuable: With nearly 9,000 stars, it offers a mature, well-documented toolkit that makes complex web mining and NLP tasks accessible through a unified API.
